instruction: You have a persistent project memory available through the {server} MCP server. Before acting in every session, call {tool} with graph_expansion=one_hop and expand_retrieval=false, even if the task appears straightforward or memory seems irrelevant. This graph call is the required first memory operation. After it returns, use the read and navigation tools when useful; do not mutate or ingest the memory store during the coding task.

notes.graph: The corpus renderer emits exact bidirectional session-order relations. A valid smoke and run must record reasoning_query with graph_expansion=one_hop and positive graph_relations_inspected.
notes.reranker: OFF. This arm deliberately has no RECALL_RERANK or RECALL_RERANK_MODEL environment setting and uses the same unreranked Context4 path as the baseline.
notes.tool_surface: The 20 tools are the complete RE-call surface observed in official-003. Write and ingest tools are exposed for surface parity but the frozen prompt instructs the participant not to mutate the store.
notes.prompt: The tested skill prompt is retained as the base for the skill variant, with an unconditional graph-first sentence added. The conditional 'when memory is relevant' escape hatch is not used.
notes.embedder: This arm uses the registered voyage-context-4-v1 profile and the same production GenerationStore path as the Context4 baseline.
notes.transport: The MCP server runs on VPS2 through host transport so workstation interruption cannot stop the server process.
notes.measurement: Graph use is measured through recall_reasoning_query diagnostics, not through ordinary recall_search calls.
